"
};
document.querySelectorAll("[data-image]").forEach(function(image) {
  image.src = embeddedImages[image.dataset.image];
});
document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form) {
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    form.outerHTML = '<div class="form-success" role="status"><span>✓</span><div><strong>Richiesta ricevuta.</strong><p>Il modulo dimostrativo è pronto per essere collegato al CRM.</p></div></div>';
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
